summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Education to establish a grant program for eligible colleges and universities to develop and implement "skills-for-success" courses for all first-year students, covering topics like mental well-being, time management, and conflict resolution.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a grant program through the Department of Education to fund 'skills-for-success' courses for first-year college students. This directly involves federal spending on higher education, which falls under public education. The bill authorizes $50,000,000 for this purpose, indicating an increase in spending.
